data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘fazaala’, meaning to help, protect or aid. In Islamic context, Fazeelah is a beautiful name for a girl, signifying the one who assists, supports and protects. The name Fazeelah carries the meaning “Protector, helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fazeelah usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
